_comment: THE per-site identity file — the only file that changes between loisirs74/73/38/…  Engine scripts read it via scripts/siteconfig.py and must never hardcode these values. department.name_i18n is deliberately ABSENT here: the 73 freezes the French place name in every language per docs/LAUNCH-PLAN.md, so dept_name(lang) falls back to "Savoie" everywhere. The 74 needs it because it renders "Alta Savoia" and "Alta Saboya".
_promo_link_comment: Hosts the publisher promotes and owns — marked rel=sponsored wherever they appear. EMPTY here: this site has no partner cards and no promoted properties. Its outbound links are editorial source citations (venue sites, offices de tourisme, patrimoines.savoie.fr) which must stay FOLLOWED — they are the evidence layer. mark_sponsored_links.py also marks every link inside a partner card structurally, so the guard covers this site the moment it grows one.
